items.title: Lew Tabackin interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Grady Tate was there. ... [INTERVIEWEE] It could be, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh wait, that wasn’t the Tonight Show band.

Well some of these guys were there. Because I remember thinking wow, what a cool thing. I know Grady Tate was there. Maybe it wasn’t even the Tonight Show band, maybe it was a kind of conglomeration. But there were some major players.
It could be, yeah. Was it Clark Terry?
